verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for Mastra, since it is a framework with thread-aware storage and a Mastra Cloud deployment target, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no export feature, open export format, or migration path for leaving. Self-hosting, multi-platform deployers and versioned evaluation datasets are adjacent features, not a documented data-export capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
